Strong detailed foreground subjects, expressive anthropomorphic animal characters, cinematic nocturnal lighting, midnight blue shadows, candle amber highlights and tiny antique brass details, sophisticated Legends of Runeterra-level collectible illustration. Maintain consistent style but distinct scenes. Each subject large and centered within its OWN tile; do not cross tile edges. Read left-to-right then top-to-bottom, depict:
row1: daring brown tavern rat stealing cheese; small mouse armored guard with round shield; muscular boar barroom bruiser swinging fist; imposing armored badger sentinel with tower shield.
row2: red fox cutpurse with twin daggers in alley; raven cutpurse stealing gold; young owl apprentice conjuring blue light; hedgehog watchman with lantern and spear.
row3: sly stoat gambler throwing dice; athletic hare runner leaping over barrels; toad brewer stirring green elixir; masked raccoon scavenger with scavenged gear.
row4: ember-tailed cinder rat in furnace shadows; black wickrunner bat swooping through candle smoke; huge ironjaw bulldog bouncer in iron armor; luminous lantern moth with tiny glowing lantern.
No labels or dividing borders. Full illustration to all tile edges. Atmospheric narrative action rather than headshot portraits.
